# Provider capabilities matrix

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/provider-matrix.mjs --write`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every row below is read from the adapter's own `capabilities()` call after a
build, so this file cannot drift from the code. It is the factual half of
[`provider-decision-guide.md`](./provider-decision-guide.md); that document
explains how to choose, this one states what each adapter declares.

An adapter appears here only if it passes the shared conformance suite in
`@tpirs/contracts`. The mock is included so a deployment can be exercised
without a provider account; it is not a candidate for production.

## PaymentProvider

Declared by `capabilities()` in `packages/ports/src/payment-provider.ts`.

`attributionKinds` decides how a payment is tied to an asset (ADR 0018). `supportsVirtualAccounts` and `supportsPaymentReferences` are convenience flags the conformance suite keeps consistent with it.

| Adapter                   | Attribution kinds                            | Virtual accounts | Payment references | Settlement fetch |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | ---------------- |
| Paystack                  | intent_reference                             | no               | yes                | yes              |
| Remita                    | intent_reference                             | no               | yes                | yes              |
| Mock (not for production) | intent_reference, virtual_account, narration | yes              | yes                | yes              |

## SmsProvider

Declared by `capabilities()` in `packages/ports/src/sms-provider.ts`.

Delivery reports are push callbacks at both real aggregators; the port models polling, so an adapter without them returns an empty list rather than inventing data.

| Adapter                   | Delivery receipts | Inbound SMS | Max segments |
| ------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------- | ------------ |
| Africa's Talking          | no                | yes         | 3            |
| Termii                    | no                | yes         | 3            |
| Mock (not for production) | yes               | yes         | 3            |

## UssdProvider

Declared by `capabilities()` in `packages/ports/src/ussd-provider.ts`.

`maxResponseLength` is what the session engine budgets a menu prompt against; exceeding it silently truncates on the handset.

| Adapter                   | Max response length | Service code in callback |
| ------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ |
| Africa's Talking          | 182                 | yes                      |
| Mock (not for production) | 182                 | yes                      |

## SettlementImport

Declared by `capabilities()` in `packages/ports/src/settlement-import.ts`.

A statement importer is a separate port from `PaymentProvider` (D21): a gateway may expose settlements through an export file rather than an API, and a bank statement has no gateway at all.

| Adapter                   | Formats | Required mapping keys                                                               |
| ------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| CSV                       | csv     | reference, amount, settledAt, settledAtFormat, amountInMinorUnits, decimalSeparator |
| Mock (not for production) | csv     | reference, amount, settledAt, settledAtFormat, amountInMinorUnits, decimalSeparator |
